messages:
Samira (CEO): Hey everyone — quick heads up: All-hands today at 4pm PT. Agenda: 1) FY27 priorities + OKRs, 2) New hybrid work policy + expectations, 3) Dedicated launch recap, 4) Live Q&A. Please drop questions below or add to the anonymous form: https://forms.gle/xyz :memo:
Maya (People Ops): Quick note on the policy item — we'll be proposing a change to core days (from 3 to 2) and a new 'on-site for launches' guideline. Will present details and the rationale. If you can't make the meeting, we'll share the recording.
Ravi (Head of Product): Product update — Dedicated GA numbers, latency p50 improvement, and usage tiers. I'll have a 6-slide summary.
Leo (Eng Lead): Will surface infra readiness, canary progress, and SLOs — plus reminders about deploy freeze windows.
Jordan (PM): Adding 3 Qs from customers we'd like answered in Q&A (pricing, rollout timeline, migration flow).
Alex (IC): Can we get slides beforehand? :eyes:
Samira (CEO): Yes — slides uploaded to the all-hands folder 10 min before start.
Maya (People Ops): Please complete the pre-meeting pulse (2 questions) so we can prioritize Qs: https://forms.gle/abc :point_up:
Samira (CEO): Also announcing a small org change — centralizing developer tools under Eng Platform. I'll explain during the exec update.
Leo (Eng Lead): TL;DR on Dedicated GA: 10% higher throughput, p95 latency down 20ms on average.
Ravi (Head of Product): Expect to show demos of migration tooling and a migration checklist.
Jordan (PM): We'll run a 10-minute live demo at the end.
Maya (People Ops): Note: hybrid policy draft will be shared in #people-ops after the meeting for feedback through EOD Friday.
Samira (CEO): See you at 4pm PT. Come with any hard questions. :coffee:
--- (post-meeting) ---
townhall-bot: Recording uploaded — https://redwood.example.com/recordings/1792501234 (auto-transcript available)
Maya (People Ops): Summary: Policy proposal (core days -> 2), on-site for major launches (expected quarterly), expanded remote stipend details. Feedback form: https://forms.gle/def
Ravi (Head of Product): Product takeaways: Dedicated GA met latency SLOs, rollout plan starts next week for early access customers, migration docs at https://docs.redwood.example.com/dedicated-migration
Leo (Eng Lead): Ops takeaways: Canary healthy, autoscale config toggled, watchlist for region eu-west-1 for next 48h.
Samira (CEO): Exec takeaways: focus on cost per token improvements, platform consolidation, hiring priority for infra SREs.
Jordan (PM): Q&A digest: pricing -> tiered per-reserved-capacity; migration timeline -> 6 weeks for pilot; support -> dedicated channel for pilot customers.
Maya (People Ops): Action items: 1) Policy feedback by Friday (file: #people-ops thread), 2) Migration playbook review (owners: @Ravi, @Leo), 3) Candidate resumes to TA for SRE hiring.
Ravi (Head of Product): Thanks all. If you asked a question in the meeting and we didn't get to it, ping me or add to the doc.
Samira (CEO): Appreciated — big week ahead. :rocket:
Jordan (PM): Post-call pulse: 4.2/5 on usefulness (preliminary).
Samira (CEO): Closing note: Recording, slides and transcript links in #all-hands and the wiki. Reach out for clarifications.
